item.title: 02.Type casting and type checking
item.description: Python is dynamically typed; variables have no fixed type. But objects do. Every object in Python carries its type with it at runtime.

item.title: 03.Operators
item.description: An operator is a symbol that performs an operation on one or more operands and produces a result.

item.title: 04.String formatting
item.description: String formatting is the process of embedding values — variables, expressions, computed results — into a string template.

item.title: 05.Input and output
item.description: Input and output (I/O) is how a Python program communicates with the outside world — reading data from the user, writing results to the terminal, reading from files, writing to files.

item.title: 06.Comments and docstrings
item.description: Comments and docstrings are both ways to embed human-readable text inside code. They serve different purposes and are used in different places.

item.title: 07.if elif else
item.description: A conditional statement evaluates a boolean expression and executes a block of code only if that expression is truthy.
